id.description: EVT-20. The answered Task's id, as TASK-28 gave it.

action.description: EVT-20. The name of the Action that answered it, one TASK-35 names for its type, as the owner's `actions` entry holds it.

contract.description: EVT-22. The id of the grant whose credential performed the Action, carried only in a delivery to a subscription the grant's applicant made, and never published to a broker.

title: Task answered
description: EVT-20. The data of `tech.rowing.worker-protocol.task-answered`: an Action was performed on a call that named this open Task (TASK-39). Whether the Task then closes is a consequence of the Facts (TASK-15). The instant is the event's `time`. At least these members; a Worker may carry more of its own.
